name: Chaos Sea (classic)
author: Joakim
description: The marker/dead-reckoning chaos-sea stepper, frozen at its long-proven pre-GMCP state - for 3K-3Kingdoms and any character or world without GMCP (needs the '=S='/'=M='/'=P' display settings and MIP for combat truth). Alias 'csc', so it loads beside the GMCP 3s-chaossea ('cs') without a fight. Maps rooms on a 3D grid by dead reckoning, queues unexplored exits, BFS-walks to the nearest frontier room; auto mode fights mobs on the way. Frozen legacy: bugfixes only - new features go to the GMCP bot. 1.3.1 (25 Oct 2026): its end-anchored triggers allow trailing whitespace, so a guild that pads its lines (a Changeling) no longer leaves the bot re-killing an empty room, and padded marker lines no longer carry the spaces into the mob name.
